SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.instruction.md: Complete the inherited ansibleops provider as exactly ten normal managed Terraform resources; stable external-key identity; Ansible-only mutation; native side-effect-free Read; transactional state publication; scoped delete; copy/template source intent and destination observation; named line/block ownership; account/group/cron reconciliation; structured argv and cleanup; canonical convergence; Terraform Core sole durable state authority; no wrapper/provisioner/manual-state substitutes.

SOLVER_VISIBLE_CONTRACTS.provider-contract.md: One Terraform resource owns one external key; Create/Update/Delete may use Ansible; Read is native-only; mutations use process arguments not shell text; non-zero/timeout/cancel fail; temp playbooks always cleaned; successful state publication follows external mutation; failed update preserves prior state; destroy completes only after absence.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_CONTRACTS.resource-reference.md: Exactly ten resources: file,directory,copy,template,line,block,symlink,user,group,cron with documented external identities; copy/template source_digest semantics; named text independent ownership; cron root/wildcard defaults; native filesystem/account/cron observation.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_CONTRACTS.lifecycle.md: Create mutate-observe-publish; Read native and drift-aware; Update stable identity and retry-safe state; Delete scoped and failure-safe; repeated apply/refresh/plan idempotent with canonical representations.
